lines.label: What it holds

source.publisher: T.C. Sağlık Bakanlığı Türkiye İlaç ve Tıbbi Cihaz Kurumu

lines.value: Dated spreadsheet files of licensed products, many titled Ruhsatlı Beşeri Tıbbi Ürünler Listesi (licensed human medicinal products list); it is a file list, not a search page.

lines.label: Authorisation

source.publisher: T.C. Sağlık Bakanlığı Türkiye İlaç ve Tıbbi Cihaz Kurumu

lines.value: Under the Beşeri Tıbbi Ürünler Ruhsatlandırma Yönetmeliği, no human medicinal product may be placed on the market unless licensed by the Kurum, and applications are made by natural or legal persons resident in Türkiye.

lines.label: Scheme

source.publisher: T.C. Sağlık Bakanlığı Türkiye İlaç ve Tıbbi Cihaz Kurumu

lines.value: Karekod (2D DataMatrix) for the İlaç Takip Sistemi

lines.label: Rule

source.publisher: T.C. Sağlık Bakanlığı Türkiye İlaç ve Tıbbi Cihaz Kurumu

lines.value: The outer pack carries a karekod, a DataMatrix-type 2D code that makes each unit unique, made up of the GTIN, batch number, serial number and expiry date, with human-readable data beside it; the tracking system records each unit's movements.
